standard_prerequisites.name: Stalks of pushforwards as cohomology of the fibre product
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the theorem describing the stalk of a pushforward as the cohomology of the corresponding base change, together with the stalk-pullback lemma
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the identification of the map in condition (2) with the map in condition (1).

standard_prerequisites.name: A map of sheaves is an isomorphism if and only if it is so on stalks
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the exactness-on-stalks theorem for the etale topology

core_obligations: Identify the two maps (proof lines 16522-16527): since Y = X x_S T one has Spec(O^sh_{X,x}) x_X Y = Spec(O^sh_{X,x}) x_S T, so the map displayed in condition (1) is exactly the stalk at x of the base change map in condition (2), by the description of stalks of pushforwards and the stalk-pullback lemma.
Conclude the equivalence (proof lines 16528-16529): the stalk criterion for isomorphisms of sheaves then makes the two conditions equivalent.
proof_roadmap: Rewrite the fibre product appearing in condition (1) using Y = X x_S T.
Identify the resulting map with the stalk of the base change map and apply the stalk criterion.
difficulty_reason: The lemma reformulates the base change isomorphism for the q-th direct image as an equality of two cohomology groups over strict henselisations (statement lines 16496-16519). The proof (proof lines 16521-16529) identifies the map in the first condition with the stalk of the base change map using the description of stalks of pushforwards and the stalk-pullback lemma, and concludes with the stalk criterion for isomorphisms. H2: one identification plus one criterion.
